pathway_models: prespecified_GBM_P1_P5_LR_other; historical choice carried forward, not selected on current Val/Test
de_budget_comparison: Report iteration-limit status only; no additional 240-generation selection
matched_input_policy: V1_MatchedInputs uses exactly the pathways retained by the split-specific Causal-BRB plus its three demographics; nine inputs only when all six pathways are retained

ml_selection.pathway9: fold-local pathway OOF for training and fold-local predictions for validation

brier_skill_reference: constant Fit prevalence, held fixed in Test bootstrap
test_bootstrap_scheme: ordinary participant resampling, identical indices for paired differences; omit one-class draws only for undefined metrics
uncertainty_groups: Val tertiles applied unchanged to Test
probability_strata: fixed calibrated probability deciles of [0,1]; report empty strata
incremental_regression: Test exploratory GLM Binomial y ~ calibrated_prob + m_Theta; HC3 robust Wald CI; raw-probability sensitivity
previous_test_exposure: v2 results were already inspected; this is a frozen repeated-split reanalysis, not a new untouched confirmatory cohort
structure_scope: Fit-only discovery per split, fixed in BRB internal CV; architecture and parameter counts may vary with discovered grouping
